name: Demise of A Blue Rose
source:
You are Aviana Beaufoy.

And you are dying.

A plague grows inside you: roses blooming in your lungs, their thorns tearing at your flesh, stealing your breath with every blue petal. Your fate has been sealed.

There is nothing you can do but hope for a little more time. 

Just for today.

She deserves to know.

She deserves the truth—that you are failing her, that the promise you swore, to stay by her side forever, is slipping from your grasp. 

All that remains is to tell her.

You must tell her.

[From [url=https://ocreatus.itch.io/demise-of-a-blue-rose]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是阿维安娜·博福伊。

而你快要死了。

一场瘟疫在你体内滋生：玫瑰在你的肺部盛开，它们的刺撕扯着你的肉体，每片蓝色的花瓣都夺走了你的呼吸。你的命运已被注定。

你无能为力，只能希望多一点时间。

就为了今天。

她值得知道。

她应该得到真相——你辜负了她，你发誓要永远留在她身边的承诺，正在从你的手中溜走。

剩下的就是告诉她。

你必须告诉她。

[来自[url=https://ocreatus.itch.io/demise-of-a-blue-rose]itch.io[/url]]
